chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan reported to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, that Hammad ibn Isa said:
I requested Abul Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon them both, saying: "May I be your ransom, pray to Allah that He may bless me with a son, and may not deprive me from Hajj as long as I live."
He says: "He prayed for me and Allah gave me this son. And whenever the days of Hajj arrived while I had no means for the expenses, Allah provided from unexpected quarters."

key_terms.أحتسب: I reckon/expect — provision came without any expectation
key_terms.الحج: Hajj — the annual Islamic pilgrimage to Mecca
key_terms.النفقة: Expenses/provisions — financial means needed for the journey
key_terms.فداك: Ransom/sacrifice for you — an expression of deep reverence used when addressing the Imams

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa al-Kadhim pray for Hammad ibn Isa regarding Hajj?
ai.summary: Hammad ibn Isa al-Juhani, a prominent companion of the Imams, recounts how he asked Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS) to pray that he be blessed with a child and never be deprived of performing Hajj. The Imam's supplication was answered: Hammad was granted a son, and whenever the Hajj season came and he lacked funds, Allah provided from unexpected sources, echoing the Quranic promise in Surah al-Talaq (65:3).
